compiled:
📰 General

Texans’ GM Hints at C.J. Stroud Trade Possibilities Following Playoff Loss •

Houston Texans General Manager, Troy Stellios, recently indicated a willingness to explore potential trades involving quarterback C.J. Stroud following the team’s Divisional Round exit. Stellios stated that the Texans would “evaluate all options” regarding Stroud’s future, suggesting a potential shift in strategy. The comments followed a 28-16 loss to the New England Patriots, highlighting the team’s shortcomings in the playoffs. This development follows a successful regular season for Stroud, where he established himself as a promising young quarterback.

🌍 World

Louvre Museum Director Resigns Amidst Investigation of Massive Jewel Theft •

Laurence des Cars, the director of the Louvre Museum in Paris, resigned following the 2025 theft of €88 million worth of crown jewels. French President Emmanuel Macron accepted her resignation as part of the ongoing investigation into the audacious crime. The theft, dubbed “the heist of the century,” involved a significant security breach at the museum. Authorities are currently examining security protocols and investigating potential suspects linked to the incident.

🦅 US

NBA Championship Contenders Emerge as All-Star Break Reveals Top Teams •

Following the recent All-Star break, several NBA teams have solidified their positions as top contenders for the 2024 championship. The Boston Celtics and Milwaukee Bucks remain at the top of many analysts’ lists due to consistent performance and strong rosters. Teams like the Denver Nuggets, fueled by Nikola Jokić’s continued dominance, and the Phoenix Suns, with a revamped roster, are also considered significant threats. Several other teams, including the Los Angeles Lakers and Boston Celtics, are vying for a playoff spot and a chance to compete for the title.

💰 Business

Trump’s Economic Claims Face Reality Check: GDP Figures Reveal Mixed Picture •

The Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) recently released an advance estimate for the US fourth-quarter GDP, revealing a 2.5% growth rate. This figure contrasts with former President Trump’s claims of having presided over the “greatest economy ever.” The growth rate, while positive, is lower than the average growth during the Obama administration. Simultaneously, the Supreme Court invalidated most of Trump’s tariffs, a factor that analysts believe contributed to the economic growth.

💻 Technology

Minecraft 26.1 Snapshot 10 Adds Particles to Monitor Mob Aging •

This latest Minecraft snapshot introduces new particle effects intended to track the aging process of mobs. The particles are designed to indicate whether a golden dandelion is successfully preventing mob aging, or if the process is being reversed. This update focuses on refining the mechanics surrounding mob aging within the game. Developers are experimenting with ways to visually represent this complex system. The snapshot represents ongoing adjustments to the game’s mechanics.

🎭 Entertainment

Halle Berry Reveals Surprising Boundary She’s Set in the Bedroom Now •

Halle Berry has discussed a significant shift in her approach to intimacy, attributing it to her perimenopause diagnosis. The actress revealed she now refuses to engage in a specific activity during sex, a change since beginning a relationship with her current partner. Berry explained that this boundary has emerged as a conscious decision related to her evolving physical and emotional experience. She emphasized the importance of prioritizing comfort and enjoyment within her intimate life. The actor’s openness highlights the impact of hormonal changes on sexual preferences and boundaries in later life.

🏅 Sports

Harry Brook’s Century Propels England to T20 World Cup Semi-Finals •

Harry Brook scored a remarkable century in England’s crucial T20 World Cup match against Pakistan. The innings saw Brook promoted to number three, following an early dismissal of Phil Salt. England ultimately secured a narrow two-wicket victory in Pallekele, advancing them to the semi-final stage. The performance highlighted Brook’s aggressive batting and proved pivotal in securing the win for the team.

🔬 Science

Amygdala’s Strategic Role Revealed: Brain’s Fear Center Also Guides Decisions •

Recent research challenges the traditional view of the amygdala as solely a fear center. Scientists discovered that the amygdala actively participates in evaluating competing options and selecting the most advantageous course of action. The study utilized fMRI scans to observe brain activity during decision-making tasks, revealing the amygdala’s involvement in weighing potential risks and rewards. This suggests a more nuanced understanding of the amygdala’s function within the broader cognitive process.

🩺 Health

Childhood Diets Significantly Alter Brain Development, Study Reveals •

Research indicates that a diet high in fat and sugar during childhood can permanently impact the brain’s appetite control center. The study, published in Neuroscience News, found that early exposure to these foods leads to lasting disruptions in the brain’s ability to regulate food intake. Scientists examined the gut microbiome and its connection to the brain, discovering specific changes linked to the dietary patterns. These alterations in the microbiome appear to contribute to long-term changes within the brain’s reward system.
